verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a REST API v1 giving programmatic access to all compute resources, and a runtime probe confirms it is live with an OpenAPI spec. It also documents a GraphQL API for Pods, templates and endpoints, an S3-compatible API for network volumes, a CLI, and MCP servers. Together these cover the main console workflows: Pods, Serverless, templates, volumes and registries. Nothing states parity with the UI beyond compute resources; billing, auto-pay, account and team settings have no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: explicit UI-parity statement, API coverage of billing/account/team management, independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Runpod REST API v1 provides programmatic access to all Runpod compute resources.
Manage Pods, endpoints, templates, volumes, and registries through the Runpod REST API.
Use the GraphQL API to manage Pods, templates, and Serverless endpoints through queries and mutations.
https://rest.runpod.io/v1/openapi.json serves the REST API's OpenAPI spec keylessly
Runpod provides an S3-protocol compatible API for direct access to your network volumes.
